shadows.name: aluminum-frame
shadows.purpose: Media frames. The edge is the elevation; no wide diffuse shadow.

narrative.overview: A dark, narrow chronological log. The page is machined: frosted glass panels, matte aluminum edges, Geist Sans for reading, Geist Mono for stamps, Geist Pixel Square as a sparse 8-bit accent.
keyCharacteristics: Command-key primary controls with no LED on the key
One dithered cyan chassis ember; 1px hard focus edges

rules.name: The Pixel Budget Rule
rules.body: Pixel Square is a fun display accent. Day-group eyebrow, tiny labels, occasional wordmark. Never body or long titles.

rules.name: The Geist Load Rule
rules.body: Load Geist through geist/font/sans, geist/font/mono, and geist/font/pixel (GeistPixelSquare). Titles, body, and UI are Geist Sans. Geist Mono is for day stamps, tags, and technical labels. Pixel is a sparse accent. No Geist Serif. Never Inter.

rules.name: The Eight-Bit Wink Rule
rules.body: 8-bit is an accent, not a retro skin. Pixel type plus 1px edges or 2x2 dither on cyan embers and focus dots only. No scanlines, CRT, chiptune, sprite backgrounds, or pixelated photos/frames.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: Do not paint zero-offset chromatic glows on type or cards. Cyan lives in color, 1px outlines, the glass catch, and one chassis ember — never as an LED on the Command key.

dos: Do keep the column near 42rem and group by day.
Do write 1–2 curated sentences. Never raw chat.
donts: Don't use beige grounds, italic-serif decoration, or rubber-stamp dates.
Don't default type to Inter or load it from next/font/google.
Don't set body copy or long titles in Geist Pixel.
Don't put a cyan LED on the Command key.
Don't pixelate photos or card frames, or add scanlines and CRT overlays.
Don't use generic purple gradients, pulsing dots, or chip soup.
Don't render paperRef or a Paper iframe.
